blocks.zh: 環境控制、確效與監測
blocks.en: Environmental Control, Validation, and Monitoring

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解環境控制 (Environmental Control) 在污染控制策略 (CCS) 中的基礎地位，以及環境污染物如何挑戰其他 CCS 要素
blocks.en: Understand the foundational role of environmental control in the contamination control strategy (CCS), and how environmental contaminants challenge the other CCS elements

blocks.zh: 掌握環境監測 (Environmental Monitoring, EM) 計畫的目的、限制及其與關鍵管控點 (CCP) 的關聯
blocks.en: Master the purpose and limitations of the environmental monitoring (EM) program and its link to critical control points (CCPs)

blocks.zh: 了解環境性能確效 (EMPQ) 的執行時機、範圍，以及再確效 (Requalification) 的觸發條件
blocks.en: Understand when and to what extent environmental performance qualification (EMPQ) is performed, and what triggers requalification

blocks.zh: 熟悉 HVAC 關鍵參數（氣流模式、壓差、溫濕度）及其對產品品質與操作人員舒適度的影響
blocks.en: Become familiar with the critical HVAC parameters (air patterns, differential pressure, temperature and humidity) and their impact on product quality and operator comfort

blocks.zh: 認識環境與公用設施中斷 (Disruption) 事件的分類及復原計畫 (Recovery Plan) 的風險分級策略
blocks.en: Recognize the categories of environmental and utility disruption events and the risk-tiered approach to recovery plans

blocks.zh: 本節目錄
blocks.en: In This Section

blocks.zh: 7.0 Environmental Control, Validation, and Monitoring 7.0 環境管制、驗證與環境監測
blocks.en: 7.0 Environmental Control, Validation, and Monitoring

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Environmental Control (環境控制)：CCS 的根基之一。環境中的污染物可透過空氣傳播 (airborne) 或表面轉移 (surface transfer) 進入公用設施、原料、設備及製程中。季節性變化（如春夏黴菌高峰）會直接挑戰其他 CCS 要素。
blocks.en: Environmental Control: One of the foundations of the CCS. Contaminants in the environment can enter utilities, raw materials, equipment, and processes through airborne spread or surface transfer. Seasonal changes (such as the spring and summer mold peaks) directly challenge the other CCS elements.

blocks.zh: Environmental Monitoring, EM (環境監測)：EM 本身不具備「預防」或「控制」污染的功能，它只是提供環境品質的離散快照 (discrete snapshots)。其核心價值在於量測污染控制措施的「績效」，並在失控前發出預警。
blocks.en: Environmental Monitoring (EM): EM itself does not prevent or control contamination; it only provides discrete snapshots of environmental quality. Its core value lies in measuring the performance of contamination control measures and giving early warning before control is lost.

blocks.zh: Critical Control Points, CCPs (關鍵管控點)：EM 計畫的有效性取決於 CCPs 的正確辨識。CCPs 通常透過 HACCP 風險評估來確定。
blocks.en: Critical Control Points (CCPs): The effectiveness of an EM program depends on correctly identifying CCPs. CCPs are usually determined through a HACCP risk assessment.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 環境監測就像醫院的「感染管控巡查」——巡查本身不會殺死病菌，但能告訴你哪裡的消毒不夠徹底、哪個病房的空氣清淨度下降了。如果巡查結果一直合格，也不代表可以減少打掃次數或不再使用漂白水。同樣地，EM 趨勢良好絕不能作為降低消毒頻率或取消殺孢子劑的藉口。
blocks.en: EM is like an infection control round in a hospital. The round itself does not kill any germs, but it tells you where disinfection was not thorough enough and which ward's air cleanliness has declined. Consistently passing results do not mean you can clean less often or stop using bleach. In the same way, a good EM trend must never be used as an excuse to reduce disinfection frequency or drop the sporicidal agent.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 兩大常見污染源：
blocks.en: Two common sources of contamination:

blocks.zh: 產孢菌 (Spore-forming bacteria)：仍是生物反應器 (bioreactor) 最常見的污染物。戶外高濃度的黴菌與產孢菌在季節高峰期可滲入潔淨室，挑戰清潔/消毒與設備滅菌計畫。
blocks.en: Spore-forming bacteria: Remain the most common contaminants in bioreactors. High outdoor concentrations of mold and spore-formers during seasonal peaks can penetrate the cleanroom and challenge the cleaning/disinfection and equipment sterilization programs.

blocks.zh: 皮膚菌 (Skin bacteria)：仍是無菌產品中最常見的污染物。操作人員是潔淨室中最大的活性污染源。
blocks.en: Skin bacteria: Remain the most common contaminants in sterile products. Operators are the largest active source of contamination in a cleanroom.

blocks.zh: 這兩個事實強調了 CCS 必須同時關注「環境面」（空氣、表面）與「人員面」（著裝、行為）的控制。
blocks.en: These two facts underline that the CCS must address both the environment (air, surfaces) and people (gowning, behavior).

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 的實務中，客戶稽核員常會檢視 EM 趨勢數據，並詢問：「當 EM 數據連續多月合格後，你們是否有調降消毒頻率？」正確的回答是：良好的 EM 趨勢是控制有效的證明，不應被用來辯護降低控制標準。反之，應利用趨勢數據來持續優化取樣策略和識別新的風險區域。
blocks.en: In CDMO practice, client auditors often review EM trend data and ask: "After several consecutive months of passing EM results, have you reduced your disinfection frequency?" The correct answer is that a good EM trend is evidence that controls are effective and should not be used to justify lowering control standards. Instead, use the trend data to keep refining the sampling strategy and to identify new risk areas.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼 EM 計畫被定義為「不預防也不控制污染」？它在 CCS 中的真正角色是什麼？
blocks.en: Why is the EM program defined as neither preventing nor controlling contamination? What is its real role in the CCS?

blocks.zh: 季節性變化如何影響潔淨室的 CCS？請舉出至少兩個具體的風險情境。
blocks.en: How do seasonal changes affect the CCS of a cleanroom? Give at least two specific risk scenarios.

blocks.zh: 如果某潔淨室的 EM 數據連續12個月零偵測 (zero counts)，這代表什麼？是否可以減少監測頻率？
blocks.en: If a cleanroom's EM data show zero counts for 12 consecutive months, what does this mean? Can the monitoring frequency be reduced?

blocks.zh: 7.1 Environmental Performance Qualification 7.1 環境效能確效
blocks.en: 7.1 Environmental Performance Qualification

blocks.zh: EMPQ (環境監測性能確效)：用文件化證據證明設施設計與環境控制措施能共同且持續地達成目標污染控制水準。它不是單一測試，而是對整個 CCS 環境控制要素的綜合評估，涵蓋：
blocks.en: EMPQ (Environmental Performance Qualification): Documented evidence that the facility design and environmental controls together, and consistently, achieve the intended level of contamination control. It is not a single test but a comprehensive evaluation of the environmental control elements of the entire CCS, covering:

blocks.zh: 設施與 HVAC 設計
blocks.en: Facility and HVAC design

blocks.zh: 人員與物料動線 (Access and flow)
blocks.en: Personnel and material access and flow

blocks.zh: 清潔/消毒程序
blocks.en: Cleaning/disinfection procedures

blocks.zh: 著裝程序 (Gowning)
blocks.en: Gowning procedures

blocks.zh: 物料轉移 (Material transfer)
blocks.en: Material transfer

blocks.zh: 害蟲防治 (Pest control)
blocks.en: Pest control

blocks.zh: ISO 14644-1:2015：潔淨室分級的國際標準，用於指導 EMPQ 取樣點的選擇。
blocks.en: ISO 14644-1:2015: The international standard for cleanroom classification, used to guide the selection of EMPQ sampling locations.

blocks.zh: EMPQ 就像新餐廳開業前的衛生檢查。你不能等到客人已經用餐後才來驗證廚房是否乾淨——必須在開業前（也就是 GMP 生產啟動前），確認所有設備就位、通風系統運作正常、清潔流程已執行且有效、員工已受過衛生訓練。只有通過這個「開業前大檢」，才能獲得營業許可（進入常規生產階段）。
blocks.en: EMPQ is like the hygiene inspection a new restaurant must pass before opening. You cannot wait until customers are already eating to verify that the kitchen is clean. Before opening (that is, before GMP production starts), you must confirm that all equipment is in place, the ventilation system works properly, cleaning procedures have been carried out and are effective, and staff have been trained in hygiene. Only after passing this pre-opening inspection do you get the license to operate (enter routine production).

blocks.zh: 執行時機要點：
blocks.en: Key points on timing:

blocks.zh: 新建區域：必須在所有設備安裝完成、CCS 程序全部建立並啟動後才執行 EMPQ
blocks.en: New areas: EMPQ must be performed only after all equipment is installed and all CCS procedures are established and in operation

blocks.zh: 既有設施變更：僅在「可能影響環境污染控制性能」的重大變更後才需要
blocks.en: Changes to existing facilities: Required only after significant changes that could affect environmental contamination control performance

blocks.zh: 氣流可視化 (Smoke Study)：必須在靜態 (static) 和動態 (dynamic/worst-case) 兩種條件下執行
blocks.en: Airflow visualization (smoke study): Must be performed under both static and dynamic (worst-case) conditions

blocks.zh: EMPQ 產出的數據直接支撐後續常規 EM 計畫的取樣點選擇，因此 EMPQ 的品質決定了日常監測的有效性。
blocks.en: The data generated by EMPQ directly support the selection of sampling locations for the routine EM program, so the quality of the EMPQ determines the effectiveness of daily monitoring.

blocks.zh: EMPQ 與日常 EM 計畫之間的關係是什麼？為什麼說 EMPQ 的品質決定了 EM 的有效性？
blocks.en: What is the relationship between EMPQ and the routine EM program? Why does the quality of the EMPQ determine the effectiveness of EM?

blocks.zh: 為什麼氣流可視化研究必須在靜態和動態兩種條件下都執行？只做靜態有什麼風險？
blocks.en: Why must airflow visualization studies be performed under both static and dynamic conditions? What is the risk of performing them only under static conditions?

blocks.zh: 7.1.1 Environmental Requalification 7.1.1 環境再確效
blocks.en: 7.1.1 Environmental Requalification

blocks.zh: Requalification (再確效)：不是「重做一次 EMPQ」，而是針對特定變更所做的確認性研究。觸發條件包括：
blocks.en: Requalification: This is not "repeating the EMPQ" but a confirmatory study targeted at a specific change. Triggers include:

blocks.zh: 結構性變更（牆壁、天花板、地板更換）
blocks.en: Structural changes (replacement of walls, ceilings, floors)

blocks.zh: 製程流程改變
blocks.en: Changes to the process flow

blocks.zh: 建材變更 (materials of construction)
blocks.en: Changes to materials of construction

blocks.zh: 區域用途改變（如從 Grade C 包裝區改為 Grade B 配液區）
blocks.en: Changes in area use (for example, from a grade C packaging area to a grade B compounding area)

blocks.zh: CCS 程序變更（消毒計畫、著裝程序等）
blocks.en: Changes to CCS procedures (disinfection program, gowning procedures, etc.)

blocks.zh: 趨勢數據出現變化
blocks.en: Changes in trend data

blocks.zh: 再確效就像汽車的定期保養檢測。即使你的車開起來好好的，每半年或一萬公里還是要回廠檢查。如果你換了引擎零件（重大變更），就要立刻回廠驗車；如果只是換了雨刷（小變更），可能不用，但如果你同時換了雨刷、胎壓感測器、又調了方向盤角度，這些累積起來就該整體檢查一次了。
blocks.en: Requalification is like the periodic servicing of a car. Even if your car runs fine, you still take it in every six months or 10,000 km. If you replace engine parts (a major change), you need to take it in for inspection immediately; if you only replace the wipers (a minor change), you may not need to. But if you replace the wipers and the tire pressure sensor and also adjust the steering angle, those changes add up and the car should be checked as a whole.

blocks.zh: 如果一個 Grade B 區域在過去6個月內進行了三次小型維修（更換一塊天花板板材、調整回風口位置、更換一盞 UV 燈），是否需要再確效？你會如何評估？
blocks.en: If a grade B area has undergone three minor repairs in the past 6 months (replacing a ceiling panel, repositioning a return air grille, replacing a UV lamp), is requalification needed? How would you assess it?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 Annex 1 對 Grade A/B 的再確效週期（6個月）比 Grade C/D（12個月）更頻繁？風險的差異在哪裡？
blocks.en: Why does Annex 1 call for more frequent requalification for grade A/B (6 months) than for grade C/D (12 months)? Where does the difference in risk lie?

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1 的週期性再確效要求：
blocks.en: Periodic requalification requirements in EU GMP Annex 1:

blocks.zh: 這是 Annex 1 的明確建議。值得注意的是，Change Control 程序需要評估「累積性變更」——也就是說，單獨看每一個小變更可能不需要再確效，但多個小變更累積起來的效應可能需要。
blocks.en: This is an explicit recommendation in Annex 1. Note that the change control procedure must evaluate cumulative changes. Each minor change on its own may not require requalification, but the combined effect of several minor changes may.

blocks.zh: 7.1.2 Environmental Monitoring Critical Parameters 7.1.2 環境監測關鍵參數
blocks.en: 7.1.2 Environmental Monitoring Critical Parameters

blocks.zh: HVAC System (暖通空調系統)：潔淨室的「生命維持系統」。它不只控制空氣清潔度，還要同時為操作人員提供安全、舒適的工作環境。三大關鍵參數（即後續小節說明的氣流模式、壓差、溫濕度）都由 HVAC 系統管控。
blocks.en: HVAC System: The "life support system" of the cleanroom. It controls not only air cleanliness but also provides a safe and comfortable working environment for operators. The three critical parameters (air patterns, differential pressure, and temperature/humidity, described in the following subsections) are all controlled by the HVAC system.

blocks.zh: Excursions (偏移)：當關鍵參數超出設定限度時的事件。程序中必須包含偏移處理與警報應對的明確指引。
blocks.en: Excursions: Events in which a critical parameter goes outside its set limits. Procedures must include clear guidance on handling excursions and responding to alarms.

blocks.zh: 7.1.2.1 Air Patterns, Air Movement, and Air Changes 7.1.2.1 氣流型態、氣流流動與換氣次數
blocks.en: 7.1.2.1 Air Patterns, Air Movement, and Air Changes

blocks.zh: Turbulent Airflow (亂流氣流)：用於 Grade B/C/D 等大部分潔淨區域。原理是透過大量換氣「稀釋」空氣中的微粒和微生物，使其懸浮後隨新鮮空氣排出。每小時換氣次數 (ACH, Air Changes per Hour) 越高，稀釋能力越強。
blocks.en: Turbulent Airflow: Used in most cleanroom areas such as grades B/C/D. The principle is to "dilute" airborne particles and microorganisms with a large volume of air changes, so that they are suspended and carried out with fresh air. The higher the air changes per hour (ACH), the greater the dilution capacity.

blocks.zh: Unidirectional Airflow (單向氣流)：用於 Grade A 關鍵區域。原理完全不同——不是稀釋，而是「掃除」。空氣以均勻、平行的方式流動，將微粒和微生物從關鍵操作區域「吹走」，確保產品只接觸到「第一氣流」(First Air)。
blocks.en: Unidirectional Airflow: Used in grade A critical zones. The principle is entirely different: not dilution but "sweeping." Air flows in a uniform, parallel manner and "blows away" particles and microorganisms from the critical operating area, ensuring that the product is exposed only to first air.

blocks.zh: First Air (第一氣流)：指從 HEPA 過濾器出來後、尚未接觸任何物體或人員的潔淨空氣。產品在關鍵操作期間只能暴露於 first air，這是無菌保證的核心原則之一。
blocks.en: First Air: Clean air that has left the HEPA filter and has not yet contacted any object or person. During critical operations, the product may be exposed only to first air, which is one of the core principles of sterility assurance.

blocks.zh: 想像兩種清潔地板的方式：
blocks.en: Imagine two ways of cleaning a floor:

blocks.zh: 亂流 = 用水沖洗浴室：大量的水沖進去，髒東西被水流帶動、稀釋，最後從排水孔流走。水量越大，沖得越乾淨。
blocks.en: Turbulent flow = rinsing a bathroom with water: A large volume of water is flushed in, the dirt is carried along and diluted by the flow, and finally washed out through the drain. The more water, the cleaner the rinse.

blocks.zh: 單向流 = 用掃把從一端掃到另一端：所有灰塵都被有方向性地推到一邊去，不會來回擾動。你站在掃把前方（first air 的位置），永遠不會碰到灰塵。
blocks.en: Unidirectional flow = sweeping with a broom from one end to the other: All the dust is pushed in one direction and is not stirred back and forth. You stand in front of the broom (the position of first air) and never touch the dust.

blocks.zh: Mouseholes（傳送窗口）就像門縫——如果沒有正確的氣流方向，外面走廊的灰塵就會從門縫鑽進手術室。
blocks.en: Mouseholes (transfer openings) are like gaps under a door: without the correct airflow direction, dust from the corridor outside will get into the operating room through the gap.

blocks.zh: 氣流可視化 (Smoke Study) 的關鍵檢查點：
blocks.en: Key checkpoints in airflow visualization (smoke study):

blocks.zh: Grade A 區域：確認單向氣流確實送達工作位置，產品只暴露於 first air
blocks.en: Grade A area: Confirm that unidirectional airflow actually reaches the working position and that the product is exposed only to first air

blocks.zh: Grade A 鄰接區域：確認無外部空氣侵入（如 mouseholes、去熱原隧道、BSC 的氣簾）
blocks.en: Areas adjacent to grade A: Confirm there is no ingress of outside air (for example, through mouseholes, depyrogenation tunnels, or the air curtain of a BSC)

blocks.zh: 亂流區域：優化佈局與監測點位置
blocks.en: Turbulent flow areas: Optimize the layout and the placement of monitoring points

blocks.zh: 必須在靜態與動態兩種條件下執行
blocks.en: Must be performed under both static and dynamic conditions

blocks.zh: 為什麼 Grade A 使用單向流而不是大幅增加亂流的換氣次數？兩者在「保護產品」的原理上有何本質差異？
blocks.en: Why does grade A use unidirectional flow rather than greatly increasing the air changes of turbulent flow? What is the fundamental difference in how the two protect the product?

blocks.zh: 如果 smoke study 顯示充填區有一個小區域存在渦流 (vortex)，這代表什麼風險？應如何處理？
blocks.en: If a smoke study shows a small area of vortex in the filling zone, what risk does this represent? How should it be handled?

blocks.zh: 7.1.2.2 Differential Air Pressure 7.1.2.2 壓差
blocks.en: 7.1.2.2 Differential Air Pressure

blocks.zh: Pressure Differential (壓差)：透過維持較高等級區域的正壓，確保空氣永遠從較潔淨的區域流向較不潔淨的區域。這是防止外部污染物侵入的物理屏障。
blocks.en: Pressure Differential: By maintaining positive pressure in the higher-grade area, air always flows from the cleaner area to the less clean area. This is the physical barrier that keeps external contaminants out.

blocks.zh: High-Potency Products (高效能/高活性產品)：面臨雙重挑戰——既要防止外部污染進入產品（正壓保護），又要防止高效能物質擴散到外部環境（負壓圍堵）。解決方案是使用具有不同壓力的 Air Locks (氣閘) 在不同分類區域之間建立壓力梯度。
blocks.en: High-Potency Products: Face a dual challenge: external contamination must be kept out of the product (positive pressure protection), and the high-potency material must be kept from spreading to the outside environment (negative pressure containment). The solution is to use air locks with different pressures to build a pressure gradient between areas of different classification.

blocks.zh: 壓差就像「風向」的人為控制。想像一棟大樓的每一層都有不同氣壓：頂樓氣壓最高，每往下一層就低一點。這樣空氣永遠是從上往下流，灰塵不可能逆流上去。潔淨室的壓差原理完全一樣——最乾淨的房間壓力最高，「空氣門」永遠朝外推。
blocks.en: Differential pressure is a man-made control of "wind direction." Imagine a building where every floor has a different air pressure: the top floor has the highest pressure and each floor down is slightly lower. Air then always flows from top to bottom, and dust cannot flow back upward. The pressure differential principle in a cleanroom is exactly the same: the cleanest room has the highest pressure, and the "air door" always pushes outward.

blocks.zh: 高效能產品的情況更像生物安全實驗室 (BSL)：你既不想讓外面的細菌進來污染你的實驗，也不想讓裡面的危險病原跑出去。這時就需要「三明治」結構的氣閘——中間是緩衝區，分別用不同壓力來控制兩個方向的氣流。
blocks.en: High-potency products are more like a biosafety laboratory (BSL): you do not want outside bacteria to get in and contaminate your experiment, and you do not want the dangerous pathogens inside to get out. This calls for a "sandwich" air lock, with a buffer zone in the middle and different pressures controlling the airflow in each direction.

blocks.zh: 壓差監測必須配備警報機制：需設定最低和最高壓力限值，當壓差偏離時立即觸發警報。這不是建議，而是基本要求。壓差的喪失意味著污染屏障的瓦解，可能導致整批產品報廢。
blocks.en: Differential pressure monitoring must be equipped with an alarm system: Minimum and maximum pressure limits must be set, and an alarm must trigger immediately when the differential pressure deviates. This is not a suggestion but a basic requirement. Loss of differential pressure means the contamination barrier has collapsed and can result in the loss of an entire batch.

blocks.zh: 如果你負責設計一個同時生產高效能抗癌藥物的無菌充填區，壓差策略應該如何規劃？畫出各區域的壓力梯度圖。
blocks.en: If you were designing a sterile filling area that also produces high-potency anticancer drugs, how would you plan the pressure strategy? Draw the pressure gradient for each area.

blocks.zh: 為什麼壓差監測需要同時設定「最低」和「最高」限值？過高的壓差會造成什麼問題？
blocks.en: Why must differential pressure monitoring set both a minimum and a maximum limit? What problems can excessively high differential pressure cause?

blocks.zh: 7.1.2.3 Temperature and Relative Humidity 7.1.2.3 溫度與相對濕度
blocks.en: 7.1.2.3 Temperature and Relative Humidity

blocks.zh: 溫濕度的雙重角色：溫度和相對濕度影響兩個面向：
blocks.en: The dual role of temperature and humidity: Temperature and relative humidity affect several aspects:

blocks.zh: 產品面：某些產品（如生物製劑、蛋白質藥物）對溫濕度敏感
blocks.en: Product: Some products (such as biologics and protein drugs) are sensitive to temperature and humidity

blocks.zh: 人員面：操作人員太冷會發抖、太熱會流汗，兩者都會導致釋放更多微粒到潔淨室中，超出無塵衣的攔截能力
blocks.en: Personnel: Operators who are too cold will shiver and those who are too hot will sweat; both release more particles into the cleanroom, beyond what the cleanroom garment can retain

blocks.zh: 微生物面：高溫高濕有利於微生物增殖
blocks.en: Microbiological: High temperature and high humidity favor microbial proliferation

blocks.zh: 溫濕度控制就像手術室的溫度設定——外科醫生穿著厚重的手術衣和手套，如果室溫太高會大量出汗，手可能打滑；如果太冷會手指僵硬，影響精細操作。無菌操作的道理完全一樣：操作人員的舒適度直接影響他們作為「污染源」的風險等級。一個流汗的操作員產生的微粒量可能是正常狀態的數倍。
blocks.en: Temperature and humidity control is like setting the temperature in an operating room. Surgeons wear heavy gowns and gloves; if the room is too warm they sweat heavily and their hands may slip, and if it is too cold their fingers stiffen and fine manipulation suffers. Aseptic operations work the same way: an operator's comfort directly affects their risk level as a source of contamination. A sweating operator can generate several times the normal number of particles.

blocks.zh: 溫濕度往往被視為「次要參數」而被忽略，但本節明確指出它對污染控制有直接影響。特別注意：操作人員著裝後（穿上無塵衣、戴手套、護目鏡），體感溫度會比環境溫度高出許多。因此潔淨室的溫度設定不能只考慮產品需求，還必須考慮穿著完整無塵衣後的人體舒適範圍。
blocks.en: Temperature and humidity are often treated as "secondary parameters" and overlooked, but this section states explicitly that they directly affect contamination control. Note in particular that once operators are gowned (cleanroom garment, gloves, goggles), their perceived temperature is much higher than the ambient temperature. The cleanroom temperature setpoint therefore cannot consider product needs alone; it must also consider the comfort range of a fully gowned person.

blocks.zh: 如果 Grade B 區域的相對濕度從 45% 上升到 70%，可能帶來哪些污染控制風險？
blocks.en: If the relative humidity in a grade B area rises from 45% to 70%, what contamination control risks might result?

blocks.zh: 在撰寫 CCS 文件時，溫濕度監測應歸類在哪個控制要素下？應如何設定行動限值 (action limits)？
blocks.en: When writing the CCS document, under which control element should temperature and humidity monitoring be classified? How should the action limits be set?

blocks.zh: 7.2 Environment and Utility Disruption and Recovery Plan 7.2 環境與公用系統中斷及復原計畫
blocks.en: 7.2 Environment and Utility Disruption and Recovery Plan

blocks.zh: Disruption (中斷事件)：指潔淨環境或關鍵公用設施（如注射用水系統 WFI、純蒸汽、壓縮空氣、HVAC）發生的任何干擾，可分為：
blocks.en: Disruption: Any interference with the clean environment or critical utilities (such as the water for injection (WFI) system, clean steam, compressed air, and HVAC). Disruptions can be classified as:

blocks.zh: Planned (計畫性)：建築工程、年度停機保養、預防性維護、設備安裝等已排程的事件
blocks.en: Planned: Scheduled events such as construction work, annual shutdown maintenance, preventive maintenance, and equipment installation

blocks.zh: Unplanned (非計畫性)：公用設施洩漏、斷電、緊急設備維修等突發事件，必須立即處理
blocks.en: Unplanned: Sudden events such as utility leaks, power outages, and emergency equipment repairs, which must be addressed immediately

blocks.zh: Recovery Plan (復原計畫)：定義從中斷到恢復「受控狀態」所需的步驟。圍堵 (Containment) 與復原的力度應與風險相稱 (commensurate with risk)。
blocks.en: Recovery Plan: Defines the steps needed to return from a disruption to a state of control. The level of containment and recovery should be commensurate with risk.

blocks.zh: Tiers of Risk (風險分級)：將不同類型和嚴重程度的中斷事件分級，每一級對應不同的圍堵策略與應變計畫。詳見 Section 17.0 Appendix III 的範例。
blocks.en: Tiers of Risk: Disruption events of different types and severity are graded into tiers, with each tier corresponding to a different containment strategy and response plan. See the examples in Section 17.0 Appendix III.

blocks.zh: 中斷與復原計畫就像醫院的緊急應變分級制度：
blocks.en: Disruption and recovery plans are like a hospital's emergency response tiering system:

blocks.zh: 計畫性中斷 = 排程手術：提前準備好所有資源、排好時程、通知所有相關人員，事後有計畫地清潔和復原。
blocks.en: Planned disruption = scheduled surgery: All resources are prepared in advance, the schedule is set, all relevant personnel are notified, and cleaning and recovery are carried out afterward according to plan.

blocks.zh: 非計畫性中斷 = 緊急送醫：沒有預警，必須立即啟動應急程序，邊處理邊評估風險。
blocks.en: Unplanned disruption = emergency admission: There is no warning; emergency procedures must be started immediately, with risk assessed as you respond.

blocks.zh: 風險分級就像醫院的「檢傷分類」(triage)——不是每個中斷事件都需要全面重新確效，輕微的可能只需加強監測，嚴重的可能需要停線、清潔、再確效後才能復產。
blocks.en: Risk tiering is like hospital triage: not every disruption requires full requalification. Minor ones may need only enhanced monitoring, while serious ones may require stopping the line, cleaning, and requalification before production can resume.

blocks.zh: 「與風險相稱」(Commensurate with Risk) 是關鍵原則：
blocks.en: "Commensurate with Risk" is the key principle:

blocks.zh: 過度反應（每次小中斷都全面停線重新確效）= 浪費資源、降低產能
blocks.en: Overreaction (a full line stop and requalification for every minor disruption) = wasted resources and reduced capacity

blocks.zh: 反應不足（嚴重中斷只做最低限度處理）= 污染風險，可能導致產品召回
blocks.en: Underreaction (only minimal handling of a serious disruption) = contamination risk, possibly leading to a product recall

blocks.zh: 正確做法是預先建立風險分級表 (risk tier matrix)，讓所有人員在事件發生時能快速、一致地做出判斷
blocks.en: The correct approach is to establish a risk tier matrix in advance so that all personnel can make quick, consistent judgments when an event occurs

blocks.zh: Annex 1 特別強調，計畫性中斷也必須有正式的控制程序——不能因為「是排程好的」就放鬆管控。
blocks.en: Annex 1 specifically emphasizes that planned disruptions must also have formal control procedures; controls cannot be relaxed just because an event was scheduled.

blocks.zh: 作為 CDMO，你的設施可能同時服務多個客戶。當發生 HVAC 異常（如 AHU 故障導致 Grade B 區域壓差喪失 30 分鐘）時，你需要：
blocks.en: As a CDMO, your facility may serve multiple clients at the same time. When an HVAC abnormality occurs (for example, an AHU failure causes a loss of differential pressure in a grade B area for 30 minutes), you need to:

blocks.zh: 依據預定的風險分級表判斷此事件屬於哪一級
blocks.en: Use the predefined risk tier matrix to determine which tier the event belongs to

blocks.zh: 啟動對應級別的圍堵策略（如隔離受影響區域、暫停操作）
blocks.en: Activate the containment strategy for that tier (for example, isolate the affected area, suspend operations)

blocks.zh: 執行復原程序（如額外清潔消毒、加強 EM 取樣）
blocks.en: Carry out recovery procedures (for example, additional cleaning and disinfection, enhanced EM sampling)

blocks.zh: 評估對所有在製批次的影響，並通知各客戶
blocks.en: Assess the impact on all batches in process and notify each client

blocks.zh: 完成偏差調查、記錄根因並更新 CAPA
blocks.en: Complete the deviation investigation, document the root cause, and update the CAPA

blocks.zh: 沒有預建風險分級表的工廠，每次都會陷入「臨時判斷」的混亂，不同班次的處理方式可能完全不一致。
blocks.en: A plant without a pre-established risk tier matrix falls into the chaos of ad hoc judgment every time, and different shifts may handle the same event in completely different ways.

blocks.zh: 請為一個無菌充填工廠設計三級風險分級表（低/中/高），列出每一級的典型事件、圍堵策略和復原要求。
blocks.en: Design a three-tier (low/medium/high) risk tier matrix for a sterile filling plant, listing the typical events, containment strategy, and recovery requirements for each tier.

blocks.zh: 計畫性中斷（如年度停機保養）和非計畫性中斷（如突然斷電），在 CCS 文件中應分別如何記載？復原要求有何不同？
blocks.en: How should planned disruptions (such as annual shutdown maintenance) and unplanned disruptions (such as a sudden power outage) each be documented in the CCS document? How do the recovery requirements differ?

blocks.zh: 如果 WFI 系統在充填作業期間發生溫度偏移（降到 70°C 以下），這屬於什麼等級的中斷？應採取哪些立即行動？
blocks.en: If the WFI system has a temperature excursion during filling (dropping below 70°C), what tier of disruption is this? What immediate actions should be taken?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 環境控制是 CCS 的基礎：環境污染物（季節性黴菌、產孢菌、人員皮膚菌）可透過空氣和表面傳播，直接挑戰設施清潔、設備滅菌和無菌操作控制
blocks.en: Environmental control is the foundation of the CCS: Environmental contaminants (seasonal mold, spore-formers, operators' skin bacteria) can spread through air and surfaces and directly challenge facility cleaning, equipment sterilization, and aseptic operation controls

blocks.zh: EM 是「測量」而非「控制」：環境監測計畫提供環境品質的離散快照，用於量測控制措施績效並預警失控，但絕不能用良好的 EM 趨勢來辯護降低控制標準
blocks.en: EM is "measurement," not "control": The EM program provides discrete snapshots of environmental quality to measure the performance of controls and warn of loss of control, but a good EM trend must never be used to justify lowering control standards

blocks.zh: EMPQ 是 EM 的基石：在新建或重大變更後的潔淨區域執行 EMPQ，其結果直接決定日常 EM 計畫的取樣策略和監測點位
blocks.en: EMPQ is the cornerstone of EM: EMPQ is performed in cleanroom areas after new construction or significant change, and its results directly determine the sampling strategy and monitoring locations of the routine EM program

blocks.zh: 再確效有明確觸發條件：結構/製程/建材變更、用途變更、CCS 程序變更、趨勢變化，以及 Annex 1 要求的週期性再確效（A/B 級每6個月、C/D 級每12個月）
blocks.en: Requalification has clear triggers: Changes to structure, process, or materials of construction; changes in area use; changes to CCS procedures; changes in trends; and the periodic requalification required by Annex 1 (every 6 months for grade A/B, every 12 months for grade C/D)

blocks.zh: 三大 HVAC 關鍵參數：氣流模式（亂流稀釋 vs. 單向流掃除）、壓差（正壓防護+高效能產品的雙向控制）、溫濕度（產品穩定性+操作人員舒適度+微生物增殖）
blocks.en: Three critical HVAC parameters: Air patterns (turbulent dilution vs. unidirectional sweeping), differential pressure (positive pressure protection plus two-way control for high-potency products), and temperature/humidity (product stability, operator comfort, and microbial proliferation)

blocks.zh: 中斷與復原必須預先規劃：區分計畫性與非計畫性中斷，建立風險分級表，圍堵與復原力度與風險相稱，避免過度反應或反應不足
blocks.en: Disruption and recovery must be planned in advance: Distinguish planned from unplanned disruptions, establish a risk tier matrix, and make the level of containment and recovery commensurate with risk, avoiding both overreaction and underreaction
